current_direction.title: CASPIAN — THE DAY THE SILENCE SANG
current_direction.story_thesis: The lyrics shape an emotional metamorph rather than a literal illustrated journey. Caspian's presence changes the hidden material of reality; the film stays portrait-led and symbolic while moving from silence through wonder, time and memory toward a warm birthday resolution.
current_direction.motion_translation: Reference-faithful living metamorph: intimate portrait composition, near-locked camera, identity anchors, slow localized material invasion/replacement, coherent A/B/C transformation states, dark sculptural relief and restrained warm fissure-light.
current_direction.reference_fidelity: Learn the reference's compositional density, metamorphic behavior, pacing and tonal restraint. Do not copy its woman, exact relief pattern or source frames verbatim.
current_direction.visual_material: Near-black charcoal/obsidian organic relief with pale/ivory subject highlights and sparse bronze-gold fissures. Water, rings, roots, maps, stars and candle motifs are expressed as internal material behaviors rather than separate literal landscapes.
current_direction.lyric_visualization_rule: Associative, not illustrative. No one-line-one-object mapping; recurring material motifs carry several lyric ideas across long transformations.
current_direction.threshold_rule: Thresholds appear as seams, apertures, light slits, shadow boundaries or material openings. Avoid repeated literal doors.
current_direction.character_rule: Use one recurring youthful central presence. Do not claim exact Caspian likeness unless a current reference photo is supplied and identity is explicitly locked.
current_direction.preview_policy: Image previews are enabled when the generation runtime surfaces them. Keeping chat light never authorizes procedural placeholder substitution.

production_asset_gate.rule: No production image generation until the new reference-led symbolic storyboard/script is locked. Do not advance to SHOT_PACKAGES_BUILT until real generated assets are manifest-recorded and each package contains hashed media_evidence.
